business_summary: Karman Line Acquisition Corp. focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. Karman Line Acquisition Corp. was formerly known as Meteora Venture Partners Acquisition Corporation VI Ltd. and changed its name to Karman Line Acquisition Corp. in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Boca Raton, Florida.
business_summary_ko: Karman Line Acquisition Corp.은 하나 이상의 기업과의 합병, 합병, 주식 교환, 자산 인수, 주식 매입, 재편성 또는 유사한 사업 결합을 수행하는 데 중점을 둡니다. Karman Line Acquisition Corp.은 이전에 Meteora Venture Partners Acquisition Corporation VI Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2025년 10월에 이름을 Karman Line Acquisition Corp.로 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2025년에 법인화되었으며 플로리다주 보카레이턴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
